strengths: Existing MW4-MW6 state/mutation/persistence/replication owners remain canonical; P7.2 creates no second Matter/terrain truth.
Optional procedural_sampler injection preserves fixed_seed_asteroid_generator default behavior.
Moon identity/geology are deterministic and body-fixed, not observer/camera dependent.
One body-fixed AABB triangle clip contract protects synchronous and streaming-worker legacy geometry/collision.
Crossing triangles preserve outside fragments; seam dead-zone is limited to explicit 0.02 m clearance.
Matter presentation/collision share one mesh source; legacy presentation/collision share the exact clipped legacy mesh.
Feature disable restores legacy-only presentation without deleting Matter snapshots.
Exact final tree passed the complete declared P7.2 gate and Project Control.

findings.summary: Initial circular legacy mask could overlap the box-shaped Matter root at corners/off-center recenter states.
findings.resolution: Replaced by body-fixed AABB triangle clipping with adversarial corner/crossing/off-center/worker coverage.

findings.summary: Exact Godot exposed inferred Variant types in bubble/presenter.
findings.resolution: Explicit Dictionary typing added without semantic change.

findings.summary: Tracked-clean gate initially treated generated untracked .gd.uid sidecars as checkout mutation.
findings.resolution: Gate ignores untracked import sidecars but still fails on tracked mutation.

findings.summary: Stale unmasked cache/worker result could reintroduce legacy geometry after Matter adapter change.
findings.resolution: Adapter changes cancel active streaming work, clear surface cache, and pass immutable body-fixed bounds to worker requests.

bounded_questions.unnecessary_complexity: Dedicated seam clipper is justified by an actual geometric ownership defect; a generic geometry foundation would increase scope without current need.
bounded_questions.duplicate_truth: None. Clipper/presenter derive geometry only; canonical Matter remains in existing owners and legacy terrain remains presentation outside root.
bounded_questions.implicit_owner: None found; adapter/runtime/presenter own no canonical state.
bounded_questions.coupling_reduction: Seam travels as immutable bounds through existing terrain request path; no new persistence/network DTO or authority foundation.
bounded_questions.sibling_surface_fix: Sync cap, streaming worker, collision-from-mesh, stale cache, rollback, P7.1 and MW4-MW6 checked.
bounded_questions.removable_code: Observer-centered circular inner-radius seam removed from production path.
bounded_questions.design_regression: No material design regression remains after body-fixed clipping repair.
bounded_questions.refactor_if_redesigned: Extract generic mesh-vs-AABB clipping only if later unrelated systems need it; doing so now would be premature foundation expansion.

nonblocking_followups: Profile clipping only if future workload proves measurable cost.
P7.3 starts only after P7.2 lifecycle closure.
